title: #80 Throw-away Society
prompt: We have entered a throw-away society and have filled the environment with rubbish. What are the causes and what are your solutions?

promptSegments.text: We have entered a throw-away society and have filled the environment with rubbish.
What are the causes and what are your solutions?

requirements.en: Identify the main problems or causes.
requirements.vi: Xác định các vấn đề hoặc nguyên nhân chính.
Đề xuất các giải pháp thực tế.

requirements.en: Explain why the solutions could work.
requirements.vi: Giải thích vì sao các giải pháp có thể hiệu quả.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The major reason is that people use things only once and throw them away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The major reason is that people use things only once and throw them away.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is to improve recycling systems in our towns.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is to improve recycling systems in our towns.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of rubbish is the high rate of consumption, where people buy and use many items, such as single-use plastic bottles, which quickly become waste.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of rubbish is the high rate of consumption, where people buy and use many items, such as single-use plastic bottles, which quickly become waste.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: An effective solution is improving waste management systems, such as setting up more recycling centers, which reduces the amount of material going into landfills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: An effective solution is improving waste management systems, such as setting up more recycling centers, which reduces the amount of material going into landfills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of environmental pollution is excessive consumerism, which generates massive amounts of single-use plastics and waste.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of environmental pollution is excessive consumerism, which generates massive amounts of single-use plastics and waste.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A viable solution involves transitioning towards a circular economy by enhancing recycling and promoting product longevity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A viable solution involves transitioning towards a circular economy by enhancing recycling and promoting product longevity.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list solutions without connecting them to the stated problems.
promptTraps.vi: Không liệt kê giải pháp mà không liên hệ với các vấn đề đã nêu.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

keyArguments: Excessive consumption and single-use plastics contribute to environmental pollution.
Implementing recycling programs and promoting sustainable consumption can mitigate the issue.
